title: Retro reads session transcripts and review comments and ranks recurring causes
body:
Source: operator 2026-11-19 marked Matt Pocock 'Watch me ship a 21,000-line feature with mattpocock/skills' (youtu.be/jVBlkOF8sHk, transcript in rss-news item 0e3384e12aa0) as very important; lead analysis mapped his loop onto KRN. Evidence: his retro skill read ~30 session transcripts plus 12 PR review comments and returned one root cause (standards silent on his review points while existing code did the opposite) and ~20 ranked fixes; KRN's delivery-retro works from the lead's memory and friction notes, krn state retro measures PR/CI/interventions only.
Files: .agents/skills/delivery-retro/SKILL.md, src/cli/state*.ts (krn state retro), test for the transcript reader
Outcome: krn state retro --sessions N reads the last N Claude/Codex session transcripts of this repo (and the PR review comments of the PRs they shipped) through subagents that each return refusals, retries, red-CI causes and operator corrections with transcript:line pointers; delivery-retro starts from that ranked list and turns each recurring item into a check, a rule or a task.
Proof: a test over two captured session transcripts (KRN-12) prints the ranked causes with pointers; one real run over the last 20 sessions lands its top 3 items as tasks or checks.
